source: Transorg Functional Spec.md, the 'Today' and 'In the POC' rows of each quarterly step; Master Spec section 1.
method: Each hand action is one thing a person does by hand that is not a judgement: re-keying numbers, moving or copying a file, composing an email or a document from blank, chasing, or comparing copies by eye. Actions are counted per loan or once per cycle. Decisions (approve, send back, decide a mark, sign off) stay with people in both columns and are not counted as savings. These are counts of actions, not hours: if AllianceBernstein shares baseline hours per step, the page uses those instead.

steps.name: Kickoff
before: Pull the active loan list from DealCloud
Write each team's kickoff email with every deadline
Send it to every deal team
now: Check the wizard's loan list, calendar and messages, then send
steps.tiq: Builds the cycle from Snowflake and drafts one message per team with its loans and dates.

steps.name: Borrower financials
before: Save each package's attachments from the inbox
File them in the loan's folder
Check by eye what is still missing
Write a chase email for anything late
now: Confirm document types TIQ is not sure of
Review and send the chases TIQ drafted
steps.tiq: Reads the inbox, classifies every attachment, files it to the loan, tracks completeness and drafts the chases.

steps.name: Share with Lincoln
before: Upload it to the Box folder shared with Lincoln
steps.tiq: Copies every complete package to Box with a manifest and records what was shared.

steps.name: Spread
before: Re-key the statements into the standard template
now: Review the cells TIQ flags and approve the spread
decisions: Approve the spread and its add-backs
steps.tiq: The Spreading Agent proposes every line with its source page; metrics and covenant tests are computed by code.

steps.name: CMR draft
before: Gather the figures from the spread
Write seven sections from a blank page
now: Edit TIQ's draft, telling it what it missed
decisions: Set the rating, watchlist and waiver recommendation
steps.tiq: Drafts every section with citations; the Review Checker flags gaps before submission.

steps.name: A/C Manager review
before: Email the draft to the reviewer and collect comments
decisions: Pass or send back with comments
steps.tiq: Routes the CMR to the right reviewer with a checklist; comments sit on the sections.

steps.name: PM Team review
before: Check the ratios against the Excel workings by eye
decisions: Pass or send back with comments
steps.tiq: Shows the PM checklist with the Review Checker's findings already filled in.

steps.name: File CMR
before: Export the CMR from Everest as a PDF
Save it to the SharePoint quarter folder
steps.tiq: Renders the PDF, files it to SharePoint and writes the CMR to Everest.

steps.name: SCT review
before: Send the filed PDF to SCT and collect comments
steps.tiq: SCT reviews in TIQ; re-filing keeps every version.

steps.name: Lincoln drafts
before: Download Lincoln's report and marks sheet from Box
steps.tiq: Watches Box, extracts point, range and yield, and cross-checks the report against the sheet.

steps.name: Tracker and impact note
before: Re-key Lincoln's point and range into the Excel tracker
Write the early impact email to Finance
now: Review and send the impact note TIQ drafted
steps.tiq: Fills the tracker from the extraction, computes values and drafts the note.

steps.name: Load to Everest
before: Key each draft mark and range into the Everest pricing panel
steps.tiq: Writes every pricing-panel row through the write-back adapter in one batch.

steps.name: Copy to SharePoint
before: Upload it to the SharePoint quarter folder
steps.tiq: Copies every report to AllianceBernstein's official folder and marks stale copies.

steps.name: Gate 1
before: Compare Lincoln's report with the CMR by hand
Write the send-back email with the numbers
decisions: Approve, approve at a different mark, or send back
steps.tiq: Puts Lincoln and the CMR side by side; the Challenge Assistant shows each difference with the math and drafts the note.

steps.name: Mark on CMR
before: Type the mark, range, approver and date into the CMR
steps.tiq: Adds the mark block to the CMR and re-files a new version on approval.

steps.name: Agenda
before: Apply the four agenda tests to each loan in Excel
now: Review the agenda the rules produced
steps.tiq: Runs the four client tests plus 'unresolved at Gate 1' on every loan, with reasons.

steps.name: Committee pack
before: Bundle the PDFs and email the committee
now: Review the drafted pack and invitation, then send
steps.tiq: Drafts the one-pagers and the meeting (date, slots, attendees) from the agenda.

steps.name: Committee meeting
before: Type up the decisions and rationale after the meeting
decisions: Decide each agenda loan's mark, rating and watchlist
steps.tiq: Captures each decision with its rationale and the Lincoln range check during the meeting.

steps.name: Reconcile
before: Compare Everest ratings with the CMR
steps.tiq: Compares every pair by code and lists only the mismatches, with both values.

steps.name: Written approval
before: Write the approval email with the schedule
Save the email and the reply to OneDrive
steps.tiq: Generates the request from the final schedule and files the request and reply as evidence.

steps.name: Governance sign-off
before: Key the approval record into Everest
steps.tiq: Writes the sign-off to Everest through the adapter.

steps.name: Distribute
before: Email Finance, Investor Relations and the Deal Teams separately
steps.tiq: Bundles the final CMRs per recipient group and logs what each received.
